notes: PROPOSAL ONLY: the actual BOD tier structure (how orders are issued, which crafts get which reward tier, how rewards are rolled) is a later roadmap item (Beta 3, BOD reward tiers) and is not decided here. This pool just proposes which cosmetic goes with which crafting profession at three tiers: 'small' (plain workshop pieces and goods), 'large' (fuller pieces) and 'exceptional' (the best-looking piece of that craft), using catalog tiers common, uncommon and scarce-to-rare to line up. Eight crafts are covered: blacksmithing, carpentry, tailoring, tinkering, alchemy, cooking, bowcraft and inscription. Weak spots: bowcraft has only commons in the catalog (the exceptional is an arrow-slit wall) and cooking and inscription share a few 'exceptional' pieces. These pieces are kept separate from artisan-signatures, so a BOD reward and a crafted signature are never the same design. Cosmetic only; no NPC resale or BOD-value, as for all catalog rewards.
